comprehension.summary: Adds a dedicated abbreviation `PresheafOfModulesOfCommRing R := PresheafOfModules (R ⋙ forget₂ _ _)` and a small API (constructors, evaluation, restriction/pushforward/pullback) so that commutative-ring–valued presheaves of modules can be written and composed without repeatedly spelling `⋙ forget₂` and without proliferating ad-hoc `...OfCommRingCat` lemmas.
